fields.Heading: Moving British Columbians Forward
fields.Text: From help at home to on the move, we keep British Columbians moving forward with proven protection and mobility solutions, including Membership, Insurance, Auto Service and Evo. Plus, as a BCAA Member, you can save over $1,500 a year on everyday essentials, insurance, experiences, travel, dining out and more! That’s the power of BCAA, and it’s moving British Columbians forward. Join the movement today!

fields.SubText1: Protection and savings. Always ready to save the day and money for our Members.
fields.Link1: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/membership" />
fields.SubText2: Local knowledge and expert advice. Providing best in class protection while helping our Members save money.
fields.Link2: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/insurance" />
fields.SubText3: Keeping you on the road. From Auto Service to Shared Mobility you can count on us.
fields.Link3: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/automotive" />

fields.Heading: Ways to save
fields.Text: As a BCAA Member, you can save up to 30% at hundreds of your favourite brands worldwide and earn up to 10% in CAA Dollars®. Explore all our savings partners and find the latest exclusive deals.
fields.Link: <link text="See more ways to save" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://portal.caarewards.ca/bcaa/" />

fields.Text1: BCAA Members save up to 20% on Award Winning Home, Optional Car, Travel, Small Business and Life Insurance.
fields.Link1: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/insurance" />
fields.Text2: Save 3¢/L on fuel and 10% on car washes & in-store purchases. BCAA Members can save over $138 per year!
fields.Image2: <image src="https://www.bcaa.com/-/media/bcaa/images/membership/ways-to-save/automotive/shell-image.jpg?la=en&h=168&w=279&hash=1D9E0D2D086F884203ADEF68A8270195" alt="Woman sitting in drivers seat of car at sunset" />
fields.Link2: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/membership/rd/shell" />
fields.Text3: Get a FREE Evo Membership, 60 FREE driving minutes, & save 10% on every trip – up to $110/year! Plus, get access to exclusive perks with Evo Extras.
fields.Image3: <image src="https://www.bcaa.com/-/media/bcaa/images/membership/ways-to-save/automotive/bcaa-evo-ways-to-save-2025.jpg?sc_lang=en&la=en&h=168&w=279&hash=C6F5B66FD61CBD679FCB44168C93E9C5" alt="Evo members with Evo parked near bridge" />
fields.Link3: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/automotive/evo-car-share" />
fields.Text4: Save up to $25/month on Rogers 5G+ mobile plans – that’s up to $300 in savings per year!
fields.Link4: <link text="Learn more" anchor="" linktype="external" class="" title="" target="" querystring="" url="https://www.bcaa.com/membership/rd/rogers" />
